'''BO-661''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Right, here is the plan. You'll need to fight your way in and in the confusion find an enemy uniform. Once you have the enemy uniform, you can give it to the pilot to make an escape.|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], to a Rebel spacer|<ref name="SWG:AWA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=faction|Rebel|Assist Wedge Antilles|Corellia}}</ref>}}
Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|battle of Yavin]], BO-661 served as a [[Galactic Marines/Legends|Galactic Marine]] and was stationed in the [[Detainment Facility]] of the [[Imperial Fortress (Yavin 4)|Imperial Fortress]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="SWG:RtfAP" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> the Empire captured and imprisoned six [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilots]] in this facility. During the [[Remembrance Day]] festivities of the same year, [[Alliance Starfighter Corps/Legends|Alliance Starfighter Corps]] [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] employed a group of loyal Rebel spacers to rescue the pilots. The Rebel operatives attacked the prison facility and killed BO-661 during the [[Rescue at Yavin 4|assault]]. One of the spacers then stole his [[Armor/Legends|armor]] so that one of the Rebel pilots could sneak out of the base in the disguise.<ref name="SWG:RtfAP" />

==Behind the scenes==
BO-661 was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RtfAP" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> BO-661 was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 11|Game Update 11]]," published on [[June 23]], [[2009]], and was present in the game during the [[W:c:swg:Empire Day|Empire Day]] events of 2009,<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 11 Empire Day">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=940830|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 11 Empire Day}}</ref> [[2010]]<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 17 - Empire Day VII / Remembrance Day VII">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1100816|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 17 - Empire Day VII / Remembrance Day VII}}</ref> and [[2011]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Star Wars Galaxies: Hotfix 19.20">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1219548|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Hotfix 19.20}}</ref>
